title: Decoding The Digital Fukú: Deciphering Colonial Legacies to Critically Assess ChatGPT in Dominican Education

bias_targets.methodology: Critical sociohistorical analysis evaluating ChatGPT's Anglo-centric, AI Global North-dominated perspectives by drawing parallels to 20th-century U.S. neocolonial education reforms and historical imperialism in the Dominican Republic.

Literature synthesis and theoretical assessment of LLMs' performance disparities, highlighting factual retrieval deficiencies in non-English languages, and the penalization of non-native English writers by AI detectors.
